description: This is a Java test class for the GCUtils utility, specifically testing garbage collection retry logic and exception handling.

classes.name: GCUtilsTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing GCUtils's garbage collection retry logic and exception handling.

classes.name: TestableGCUtils
classes.description: A subclass of GCUtils used to override doGarbageCollection for testing purposes, tracking the number of times garbage collection is invoked.

classes.name: FailureAnswer
classes.description: An implementation of Mockito's Answer interface that simulates a specified number of OutOfMemoryError failures before succeeding.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test objects before each test.

methods.name: testNoRetry
methods.description: Tests that performOperationWithMemRetry executes the operation without retries when no error occurs.

methods.name: testMaxRetryAndThrowException
methods.description: Tests that performOperationWithMemRetry throws OutOfMemoryError after exceeding maximum retries.

methods.name: testSomeRetry
methods.description: Tests that performOperationWithMemRetry retries the correct number of times when intermittent OutOfMemoryError occurs.

methods.name: testOneRetry
methods.description: Tests that performOperationWithMemRetry retries once when a single OutOfMemoryError occurs.

methods.name: testDoGarbageCollectionDoesNotFail
methods.description: Ensures that doGarbageCollection does not throw exceptions during normal operation.

methods.name: setupOutOfMemoryError
methods.description: Configures the mock operation to throw OutOfMemoryError a specified number of times before succeeding.
